items.title: Artistic Tulip Flower and Butterfly Silhouette Vector for CNC Art
items.description: Expand your decorative vector catalog with this beautiful biophilic silhouette design featuring blooming tulip flowers and a flying butterfly. Moving away from abstract geometry, this scenic nature-inspired vector art is tailored in DXF, SVG, and DWG formats for artistic metal plasma cutting, CNC wood routing, and custom laser-cut wall murals. Perfect for enhancing garden gates, outdoor fences, courtyards, and cozy cafes.
